name: Open Charge Map
tagline: Crowdsourced global EV charging location database with free API access.
description: Open Charge Map provides a free, open API to query a global database of electric vehicle charging stations. Developers can search by location, filter by connector type and network, and retrieve detailed site data including equipment, access, and status. Access requires a free API key with documented rate limits for fair use.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header or key query parameter; free self-serve registration required

use_cases: find EV chargers near a lat/lng
list charging stations by country or region
filter chargers by connector type or power
check operator/network for a charging site
get detailed POI data for a known station ID
